data: Amazon reported total assets of $818,042 million (about $818.0 billion) at December 31, 2025, the end of its fiscal 2025, while NVIDIA reported $111,601 million (about $111.6 billion) at January 26, 2025, the end of its fiscal 2025. Amazon's assets are roughly 7.3 times NVIDIA's ($818,042 million divided by $111,601 million). The two fiscal years end about eleven months apart, so NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 closed almost a full year before Amazon's, which slightly affects the comparison.
